notes: Inkling-2-Mini (NVFP4 / MXFP8, looped MoE) on Ferrite's own Rust engine (--engine ink), one RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell 24 GB, one request at a time, speculative decoding with the model's own draft head (lossless: greedy output is identical with INK_NODRAFT=1). Typed-message markup: reasoning in <|content_thinking|> messages (-> reasoning_content), tool calls as <|content_invoke_tool_json|> messages with {"name":..,"args":{..}} (-> tool_calls, arguments streamed as written); reasoning_effort / chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking map onto the template's reasoning effort (off = 'none', which still reasons a little); tool_choice required / named is a system hint only (no forced opener). No server-side reasoning cap besides the 16384-token backstop (finish_reason length), no loop breaker, default sampling = the model's generation_config (temperature 1.0).
